title: Ocular prophylaxis for gonococcal ophthalmia neonatorum in newborns

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends prophylactic ocular topical medication for all newborns to prevent gonococcal ophthalmia neonatorum.

action: Administer prophylactic ocular topical medication to all newborns to prevent gonococcal ophthalmia neonatorum.

derived.min: 'newborns' interpreted as infants born during the measurement year (age 0 at Dec 31); no age number stated in text
derived.max: 'newborns' interpreted as infants born during the measurement year (age 0 at Dec 31); no age number stated in text

numerator.note: Intended to be given shortly after birth; window approximates birth during the measurement year.
